rules.title: forwardRef is deprecated; ref is a standard prop on function components
rules.description: In React 19+, ref is available as a standard prop passed directly to function components. forwardRef wrapper is deprecated and will be removed in React 20.

remediation.summary: Remove forwardRef wrapper and receive ref directly in component props.

rules.title: defaultProps on function components has been removed in React 20
rules.description: Defining defaultProps on function components has been removed. Use JavaScript default parameter values in the component arguments list.

remediation.summary: Replace defaultProps with ES6 default parameter destructuring in component arguments.

rules.title: Legacy Context API (contextTypes, childContextTypes) has been removed in React 20
rules.description: The legacy Context API using contextTypes and childContextTypes has been completely removed in React 20. Use React.createContext() and the use(Context) hook.

remediation.summary: Migrate legacy contextTypes to React.createContext() and the use(Context) hook.

rules.title: react-dom/test-utils package has been completely removed in React 20
rules.description: react-dom/test-utils has been completely removed in React 20. Migrate unit tests to @testing-library/react and import act from 'react'.

remediation.summary: Remove react-dom/test-utils imports and migrate to @testing-library/react.
